summary: ZKH Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The press release details operational and financial highlights, including GMV growth of 18.9% year-over-year, net revenues of RMB 2.44 billion (up 12.8%), and a first-time operating profit. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, or strategic reviews. Comments from the Chairman/CEO and CFO provide business outlook and operational context. No deal terms or transactional mechanics are present. This is a standard periodic report, not an event-driven special situation.
